held.title: The new import path `transactions.utils` may not match the existing `transaction.utils` module.
held.body: The line just above imports `parseApprovalTransactionData` from `shared/lib/transaction.utils` (singular). The new line imports `hasTransactionType` from `shared/lib/transactions.utils` (plural). If only the singular file exists, or `hasTransactionType` lives somewhere else, module resolution fails. The hook would then break for every transaction confirmation, not just pay flows. I couldn't confirm which file exists. Check that `shared/lib/transactions.utils` exports `hasTransactionType`; if it doesn't, import it from the correct module.
